summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which uses hex-obfuscated identifiers to resolve a platform-specific Bun binary, downloads Bun v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line obfuscated blob (bun-cjs header, string-array shuffler and rotation-based decoder over a large numeric constant table) that runs under the fetched Bun runtime at install time. The package's advertised purpose in src/Chat.ts and README is a trivial browser window.open chat popup wrapper, which has no need for a second language runtime or a 727KB obfuscated payload at preinstall. Executing the payload under Bun rather than Node evades Node-based inspection. The behavior fires automatically on npm install via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
